description: D3 (qou-btvl) + qou-52sn: recompute the Route-A cross-knot boundary slopes with SnapPy 3.3.2 normal_boundary_slopes() (spun-normal, FXrays exact integer output). Hardens the literature-recalled 4_1 {+-4} and 5_2 {0,-4,-10} (magnitude sets convention-independent; SnapPy sign convention differs from Hatcher-Oertel and is recorded as-is). New 6_1 datum |slopes| = {0,4,8}; no 6_1 DT spectrum exists in corpus or carried literature, so no R1/R2 comparison is made. Volume cross-checks are float64-tier informational. Scope-(a); nothing wired. Beans qou-btvl / qou-52sn.
